title.en: Big playground morning at Pasir Ris Park
title.zh: 上午去白沙公园玩大型游乐场

note.en: Go early, before the heat and the afternoon showers. There's little shade, so bring hats and water. If it rains, Tampines Library is close by.
note.zh: 早点去，避开中午的炎热和午后阵雨。树荫不多，记得带帽子和水。下雨的话，附近有淡滨尼图书馆。

title.en: Rain or shine: library and art room
title.zh: 下雨也不怕：图书馆和美术室

note.en: The ocean-themed children's library at the National Library, then free art play at the National Gallery's Keppel Centre, best for ages 4 and up.
note.zh: 先去国家图书馆的海洋主题儿童图书馆，再去国家美术馆的吉宝艺术教育中心免费玩美术，适合4岁以上。

title.en: Water play, then the Science Centre

note.en: Water play at Jurong Lake Gardens' Clusia Cove in the morning (pack spare clothes), then the Science Centre after lunch. KidsSTOP, for under-8s, needs booking.
note.zh: 上午在裕廊湖花园的Clusia Cove玩水（带替换衣服），午饭后去科学馆。8岁以下的KidsSTOP需要预约。
